mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of rising unemployment are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, reducing corporate revenue growth and compressing earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of falling consumption are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate to above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of FEDFUNDS > 4.5% are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production signals weakening economic activity and lower corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of falling industrial production are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 8% signals a deep labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of UNRATE > 8% are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with a sustained 3-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening aggregate demand, reducing corporate revenue growth and compressing earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of falling RSAFS and HOUST are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 8% combined with a sustained 3-month decline in industrial production signals a deep economic contraction, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of UNRATE > 8% and falling INDPRO are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
